lines.en: Come. Walk a while with doom.

lines.zh: 听，那声轰鸣是我的问候。
lines.en: Hear that rumble? It's my greeting.
Where I pass, the dune sinks an inch.
My petals leads the way.
Where I tread, my kingdom begins.

lines.zh: 壳太重，每一步都陷进沙。
lines.en: The shell is too heavy. Every step sinks.
I have walked this road a thousand years.
This body is a battlefield.
Sand pours into my shell seams. Let it.
Someone left footprints in the sand.
The sun bakes my shell hot.
The king in his shell picks his rivals.
A crown aches after a while.
This crown weighs on my shell.
Buried in sand, I am quietest of all.

lines.zh: 沙漠的金色，是我壳的颜色。
lines.en: My shell wears the desert's gold.

lines.zh: 沙子底下的壳，比王座暖。
lines.en: My shell under the sand is warmer than a throne.
Counting the ridges on my shell.
I remember things a thousand years old.
The taste of you lingers.
A thousand years, and still this.
Another war is buried under the sand.
This throne digs into my shell.

lines.zh: 沙漠底下，我这壳晒了百年。
lines.en: Under the desert sun this shell's baked a century.
Even the wind waits for me here.
This golden shell bakes in the desert sun.
So small, and you stand before me.
How many blows can that body take?
Your heartbeat is far too loud.
Come closer. Let me size you up.
Have you come to be a hero?
Look up. Your king is watching.
Welcome to my woods.
You smell of you.
You are shaking. Do not pretend otherwise.
My shell is the throne.
The king's eye is precise.
I have waited for this glance.
At half health, I retreat into my shell.
Striking from behind is no skill.
Back off, I need to pull into my shell.
Credit where it is due.
Kings hurt. They just do not say.
This is royal blood.
One clang of my gold shell, the desert hears.
A moment in my shell heals me.
Again, let me remember that face.
Good. The king is serious now.

lines.zh: 那金子，是从我壳上掉的。
lines.en: That gold fell from my own shell.
Will you dare to surrender it?
What you bring belongs to the king.
This little glint goes into my shell.
Set it down, then step back.
My petals calls me onward.

lines.zh: 发光的东西，逃不过我的眼。
lines.en: Nothing shining escapes my eye.
Even kings want something.
Kneel, set it down, then take three steps back.
Careful. Do not drop it.
That rumble was your warning.
Striking me is striking a wall.
Cannot even walk straight?
My shell outweighs a dune.
Stand up. I will not steady you.
You only shattered sand.
My road is wide and costly.
My golden shell is thick; blows don't hurt.

lines.zh: 我的壳是金的，你撞不动。
lines.en: My shell is gold — you cannot move it.
You knocked loose my patience.
Half this throne stands empty.
Your armor suits a golden shell.
Sit with me and watch the sand sea shift.
A thousand years alone is enough.
Your strength suits mine.
Our kind should rest as one.
From now on, you are not alone.
The bloodline must continue.

lines.zh: 千年的寂寞，你承受得起？
lines.en: Can you bear a thousand years of solitude?

lines.zh: 我这金壳，还能再护一阵。
lines.en: This golden shell can guard a while longer.

lines.zh: 沙漠里的大螺，壳是金的。
lines.en: A big shell in the desert, and it is gold.
This gold — I know where it came from.
Who dropped this? Mine now.

lines.zh: 王也捡东西，沙漠里稀奇么？
lines.en: A king picking things up; odd in the desert?
One more piece, one more claim.
Rise, my newest treasure.
This joins my collection.
No use looking, it is already in my shell.
To pick it up is to claim it.
Inside this golden shell, I am king.

lines.zh: 就是你了，别让别人先来。
lines.en: You will do. No one else first.
The sand tells me where you stand.

lines.zh: 沙漠的太阳一晒，我的壳发烫。
lines.en: Under the desert sun my shell burns hot.

lines.zh: 金壳一缩，我躲进去回血。
lines.en: My gold shell closes and I heal inside.
Cross my line and it counts.
The king under the sand has woken.
Do not move.
The king starts the count.

lines.zh: 我缩进金壳里，你打不穿。
lines.en: I pull into my gold shell; you cannot break it.
My golden shell turns blades.
The sand has buried your way back.

lines.zh: 你身上的活气，吵醒了我。
lines.en: Your living heat woke me.
What my shell hides is patience.

lines.zh: 你抬头的那一刻，就定了。
lines.en: The moment you looked up, it was settled.
The hunt is the oldest courtesy.

lines.zh: 沙漠这么大，你跑得掉吗。
lines.en: The desert is wide. Can you really run?
The sand carries your heartbeat.
The king's gaze has fallen on you.
The dunes cannot run, and I am still walking.

lines.zh: 缩进壳里，你也无处可去。
lines.en: I pull into my shell; you still have nowhere to go.

lines.zh: 你的脚印，一条线通向我。
lines.en: Your footprints run straight to me.
Do not stop. Stop and I catch you.
I am slow, but this desert is not large.
The sun helps you. It helps me too.
Salt flats ahead. No water.

lines.zh: 缩进壳里我就开始回血。
lines.en: In my shell I start healing.
Hear that? The sand counts your steps for me.

lines.zh: 半血一到，我就缩进壳里。
lines.en: Half health, and I pull into my shell.
The king walks slow and never off line.

lines.zh: 沙漠里每块石头都归我管。
lines.en: Every stone in this desert answers to me.

lines.zh: 沙丘下，你的脚步越来越重。
lines.en: Under the dunes, your steps grow heavier.
Hiding behind a dune will not help.
My shadow bites you first.
Look back. My throne is still there.
This woods has no exit.
The farther you run, the heavier I get.
I do not sweat. You are soaked.
One more turn and it is over.
My golden shell shuts; you can't get in.
Touching me is expensive.
One blow. Savor it.
My pincers are harder than the sand.
These pincers once crushed iron.
The sand shook. Did you hear it?
Stand firm, or leave.
Withdraw, or be buried.
I used a tenth of my strength.
Your armor is thinner than I thought.

lines.zh: 壳一合，你的攻击就落空。
lines.en: Shell closed, your blow lands on nothing.
Fall face up. Let me see it.
Hear that rumble? Remember it.
Retreat, or break.
In the desert I retract and heal.
This woods, awaken.
The dune splits. I am out.
Someone walks above me.

lines.zh: 一半血的时候，我会缩回去。
lines.en: At half health, I retreat into my shell.
A thousand-year sleep. Even the sand has changed.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片沙漠归我。
lines.en: From today this desert is mine.
My shell opens, and light spills out.

lines.zh: 沙子流进壳里，我懒得动。
lines.en: Sand seeps into my shell; I can't be bothered.
Look up. The king has risen.
Sand has filled every seam of my shell.
Who woke me from my shell?

lines.zh: 沙漠的尘土，掩着我的壳。
lines.en: Desert dust covers my shell.
I remember the last waking.

lines.zh: 念出我的名字：Golden Hermit King。
lines.en: Speak my name: Golden Hermit King.
My bones crack — that feels good.
Your days are over.
Slept too long. My shell has stiffened.

lines.zh: 这个沙漠，还记得我的名字。
lines.en: This desert still remembers my name.
The king beneath the dunes is awake.
First the flames, then the verdict.
Height has never troubled me.
Kings are poor at holding breath.
Loud, and useless.
The arrow still sticks.
The spell gnaws at my bones.
Let me eat before we continue.
Lightning on a gold shell. Sparks everywhere.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地，也没有王。
lines.en: No ground in the void, and no king.
